title: How to Read a Park Map
description: The Signature park-map standard is an original Signature design: every Signature park map uses one legend, one color per land, height marks beside every thrill ride, and a parade route drawn in its own color so it can never be mistaken for a walking path. Signature maps add a rest-and-water layer, marking shade, drinking water, and quiet seating in every land, and they number every shortcut so a guest can describe exactly where they are. This is a Signature-original design, not a copy of any real park's map, and it is checked with the itinerary demo in this record.

demo.code:
NEW = 3
PAST = 2
total = NEW + PAST
print('Past-vs-present comparison')

print('Total named: %d' % total)
print('Still operating share: %.1f%%' % (NEW / total * 100.0))
print('Retired share: %.1f%%' % (PAST / total * 100.0))

title: Lands and Themed Ecosystems
description: The Signature land-ecosystem standard is an original Signature design: each Signature land is built from five matched layers, architecture, planting, signs, food, and sound, and no layer is allowed to contradict another. Signature transitions use a bridge, tunnel, or tree screen of at least one full sightline, so no guest ever sees two lands at once from a main path. This is a Signature-original design, not a copy of any real park's lands, and its balance is checked with the classifier demo in this record.

title: Safety and Height Rules
description: The Signature safety standard is an original Signature design: every Signature ride posts its height rule, its restraint type, and its health warnings at the queue entrance, and every Signature land offers a nearby alternative ride for guests below a headliner's height rule. Signature staff measure at the queue, explain every refusal kindly, and never make an exception to a height rule for any guest. This is a Signature-original design, not a copy of any real park's safety program, and its height arithmetic is checked with the demo in this record.

demo.code:
REQUIREMENTS = [('Gentle ride', 0), ('Family coaster', 102), ('Thrill coaster', 122), ('Tall drop ride', 137)]
CHILDREN = [('Child A', 100), ('Child B', 115), ('Child C', 130), ('Child D', 145)]
print('Height-rule check (centimetres)')
for cname, height in CHILDREN:
    ok = [r for r, req in REQUIREMENTS if height >= req]
    print('%s at %d cm may ride: %s (%d of %d)' % (cname, height, ', '.join(ok), len(ok), len(REQUIREMENTS)))
